description: Solar Consumer is software for pulling solar generation and forecast feeds into a PostgreSQL database. Its README names source interfaces for Great Britain, the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium and Rajasthan, including NESO, PVLive, Ned NL, ENTSO-E, Elia and RUVNL. Users configure selected feeds and storage, then collect national, regional or embedded-generation estimates. The outputs are time-stamped series for downstream analysis, not a fixed dataset embedded in this repository. Geographic coverage is the regions with implemented source adapters. GitHub metadata states MIT licensing for the collector; provider feed terms remain separate. A limitation is that different operators publish forecasts and actuals at different spatial and time resolutions, so their fields are not interchangeable without checks. The tool can assemble calibration and demand-balance inputs for solar grid simulations. The related ERA5 catalogue record supplies weather reanalysis, not generation observations. No live feed or database was downloaded.
name: Solar Consumer generation-feed collector
